## Activity

During November 2020, East City Eye Clinic completed 127 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded activity provides the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading. Capture activity was documented for the month and processed through the usual workflow, allowing images to move from acquisition to assessment without additional information being required in this report.

## Image quality

Image-quality review recorded an ungradable count of 0. The ungradable rate was 0.0, indicating that all captured images were available for grading. This result reflects the quality of the submitted images during November 2020 and indicates that no captures were excluded from assessment on image-quality grounds.

## Grading

Grading identified 18 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure summarises the interval between image acquisition and completion of grading across the month. Overall, the recorded workflow shows that the images captured at East City Eye Clinic were graded with no ungradable images reported and that referable results were identified for appropriate follow-up through the relevant clinical process.
